reconcile.note: Henry distinguishes the childlike humility Christ commends from the childish folly and fickleness Paul condemns, treating them as different senses of the same word.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues the same word-family pairing as a flat contradiction between becoming like a child and putting away childish things.

sides.snippet: unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.
sides.verseText: and said, \"Most assuredly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

sides.snippet: Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
sides.verseText: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
